# CI workflows

<!-- Generated by `go run ./test/ciworkflows` from .github/workflows, test/ciworkflows/inventory.json and conformance/registry/generated/verification/workflow-runs.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every workflow under `.github/workflows`, grouped by what starts it. The triggers and schedules are read from the workflow files; the group, what each workflow verifies and whether its check is required for a merge come from `test/ciworkflows/inventory.json`. A pull request that adds, removes or renames a workflow, or changes its triggers, regenerates this page (`go run ./test/ciworkflows`); the lint job fails otherwise.

The last-run columns are filled by the daily report from the GitHub API; recorded 2026-11-18T08:19:38Z.

## Pull request gates

| Workflow | Triggers | Verifies | Required | Last run on main | Last scheduled run |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `change-scope.yaml` Change scope | workflow_call | Reusable: reports which lanes of jobs a pull request needs (product, stack, baseline) from its changed files. | no | pull requests only | not scheduled |
| `changelog-pr.yaml` Changelog PR | pull_request (main; types opened, synchronize, reopened) | A pull request that changes shipped code carries a CHANGELOG entry under Unreleased. | no | pull requests only | not scheduled |
| `ci.yaml` CI | pull_request (main)<br />push (main; 4 paths-ignore)<br />workflow_dispatch | Unit tests, race, fuzz smoke, lint, conformance gate, image, compose stacks (e2e-compat, fleet, UI), helm and docker checks. | yes | [failure 2026-11-17](https://github.com/ReliablyObserve/loki-vl-proxy/actions/runs/44174572235) | not scheduled |
| `codeql.yaml` CodeQL | pull_request (main)<br />push (main; 4 paths-ignore)<br />schedule `0 6 * * 1` (weekly, Monday 06:00 UTC)<br />workflow_dispatch | CodeQL analysis of the Go code and the workflows, also weekly on main. | yes | [success 2026-11-17](https://github.com/ReliablyObserve/loki-vl-proxy/actions/runs/44174571823) | [success 2026-11-16](https://github.com/ReliablyObserve/loki-vl-proxy/actions/runs/43816295397) |
| `compat-drilldown.yaml` Logs Drilldown Compatibility | pull_request (main)<br />push (main; 4 paths-ignore)<br />schedule `45 3 * * 1` (weekly, Monday 03:45 UTC)<br />workflow_dispatch | Logs Drilldown compatibility against the pinned and matrix Grafana and plugin versions. | yes | [success 2026-11-17](https://github.com/ReliablyObserve/loki-vl-proxy/actions/runs/44174572266) | [success 2026-11-16](https://github.com/ReliablyObserve/loki-vl-proxy/actions/runs/43800124711) |
| `compat-loki.yaml` Loki Compatibility | pull_request (main)<br />push (main; 4 paths-ignore)<br />schedule `15 3 * * 1` (weekly, Monday 03:15 UTC)<br />workflow_dispatch | Loki API compatibility against the pinned Loki and the Loki version matrix. | yes | [success 2026-11-17](https://github.com/ReliablyObserve/loki-vl-proxy/actions/runs/44174572227) | [success 2026-11-16](https://github.com/ReliablyObserve/loki-vl-proxy/actions/runs/43798111776) |
| `compat-vl.yaml` VictoriaLogs Compatibility | pull_request (main)<br />push (main; 4 paths-ignore)<br />schedule `15 4 * * 1` (weekly, Monday 04:15 UTC)<br />workflow_dispatch | Compatibility with the pinned VictoriaLogs and the supported VictoriaLogs version matrix. | yes | [success 2026-11-17](https://github.com/ReliablyObserve/loki-vl-proxy/actions/runs/44174572215) | [success 2026-11-16](https://github.com/ReliablyObserve/loki-vl-proxy/actions/runs/43803841133) |
| `e2e-pipeline.yml` E2E Pipeline | pull_request (main)<br />push (main; 4 paths-ignore)<br />workflow_dispatch | The end-to-end ingest pipeline stack answers through the proxy. | no | [success 2026-11-17](https://github.com/ReliablyObserve/loki-vl-proxy/actions/runs/44174572226) | not scheduled |
| `perf-ab.yaml` Perf A/B | pull_request (main; types opened, synchronize, reopened) | Per pull request A/B smoke of the base build, the PR build and Loki over the shapes the change selects. | no | pull requests only | not scheduled |
| `pr-evidence-summary.yaml` PR evidence summary | workflow_run (CI, PR Quality Report, Perf A/B, Visual smoke, Loki Compatibility, Logs Drilldown Compatibility, VictoriaLogs Compatibility, Security PR; types completed) | Summarises the evidence artifacts of a pull request's finished runs; runs no pull request code. | no | [success 2026-11-18](https://github.com/ReliablyObserve/loki-vl-proxy/actions/runs/44265644136) | not scheduled |
| `pr-quality-report.yaml` PR Quality Report | pull_request (main; types opened, synchronize, reopened) | Base against head quality report: coverage floor, tests, query corpus, compatibility scores and tracked performance. | yes | pull requests only | not scheduled |
| `release-pr-validation.yaml` Release PR Validation | pull_request_target (main; types opened, synchronize, reopened, edited, ready_for_review)<br />workflow_dispatch (inputs: pr) | The bot's release metadata and report pull requests carry only the files the bot may write. | no | none | not scheduled |
| `security-pr.yaml` Security PR | pull_request (main)<br />push (main; 4 paths-ignore)<br />workflow_dispatch | Static security checks and the runtime security smoke of the pull request build. | yes | [success 2026-11-17](https://github.com/ReliablyObserve/loki-vl-proxy/actions/runs/44174572268) | not scheduled |
| `visual-smoke.yaml` Visual smoke | pull_request (main; types opened, synchronize, reopened, labeled, unlabeled) | Grafana Explore and Logs Drilldown screenshots of the base build, the PR build and Loki for the pages the change touches. | no | pull requests only | not scheduled |

|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `docs-site.yaml` docs-site | pull_request (4 paths)<br />push (main; 4 paths)<br />workflow_dispatch | Builds the documentation site on pull requests that touch it and deploys it from main. | no | [success 2026-11-17](https://github.com/ReliablyObserve/loki-vl-proxy/actions/runs/44185042821) | not scheduled |

## Daily

| Workflow | Triggers | Verifies | Required | Last run on main | Last scheduled run |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|

| `query-corpus.yaml` Query Corpus | push (main)<br />schedule `23 2 * * *` (daily 02:23 UTC)<br />workflow_dispatch | Builds the query corpus of main and re-verifies the recorded Loki and VictoriaLogs answers, differentials and the grammar sweep with the live oracles. | no | [success 2026-11-18](https://github.com/ReliablyObserve/loki-vl-proxy/actions/runs/44223484610) | [success 2026-11-18](https://github.com/ReliablyObserve/loki-vl-proxy/actions/runs/44223484610) |
| `security-heavy.yaml` Security Heavy | schedule `0 4 * * *` (daily 04:00 UTC), `0 6 * * 1` (weekly, Monday 06:00 UTC)<br />workflow_dispatch | Image and SBOM scan, semgrep, long fuzzing and the DAST scan of a running proxy. | no | [success 2026-11-18](https://github.com/ReliablyObserve/loki-vl-proxy/actions/runs/44234824781) | [success 2026-11-18](https://github.com/ReliablyObserve/loki-vl-proxy/actions/runs/44234824781) |

## Release

| Workflow | Triggers | Verifies | Required | Last run on main | Last scheduled run |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `auto-release.yaml` Auto Release | push (main)<br />workflow_dispatch | On every push to main: decides from the changelog whether a release is due, validates, tags, builds, signs and publishes it, and refreshes the release metadata pull request. | no | [success 2026-11-17](https://github.com/ReliablyObserve/loki-vl-proxy/actions/runs/44185042780) | not scheduled |
| `release.yaml` Release | workflow_dispatch (inputs: dry_run, tag) | Manual republish of a release tag: binaries, SBOMs, provenance, signatures, images (GHCR and Docker Hub), Helm chart and release assets. | no | [success 2026-11-16](https://github.com/ReliablyObserve/loki-vl-proxy/actions/runs/43798660323) | not scheduled |
